activeFamilyContract.wordFirst: Supermarket must receive three distinct pre-phrase contacts before scored phrase use.
activeFamilyContract.listenChoose: Each localized choice must express only the exact spoken meaning.

ownerCorrectionDesign.sceneIntegrity: Use only a plausible delivery leaflet: a listing can state one supermarket or several shops. Do not invent a courier, customer, or misread sign merely to force a reply.
wordFirstContacts: listen_choose: supermarket versus sound-near real words
context_gap_grammar: supermarket as one selectable answer
ownerCorrectionDesign.wordFirstRule: Exactly three distinct standalone contacts for supermarket occur before any full phrase containing supermarket; each is one interaction and none bundles another target.
ownerCorrectionDesign.targetUniqueness: Every practice interaction has a unique primary target. Intro exact targets are not reused verbatim in practice or final; variation must change the assessed phrase, not just task-family label.
ownerCorrectionDesign.sequencing: No adjacent phrase_builder interactions. Alternate supported families and keep the final after fading support.
ownerCorrectionDesign.vocabularyBoundary: Only supermarket is new. pharmacy, library, bakery, garden, bank, post office, shop(s), house, near, small, quiet and new are retrieval/support only; no future vocabulary or grammar is introduced.
ownerCorrectionDesign.parity: Author must maintain exact RU/UK and atomic-source parity for interaction order, targets, options, audio transcript, correctText and response-specific feedback before release.
ownerCorrectionDesign.tasteRepair: Mandatory narrow repair: include the requiredTasteRepair line once in each locale’s plural-shops intro explanation. It is a language-based joke about a fitting only one item, tied directly to the leaflet’s singular/plural contrast; do not invent any decorative scene detail.

requiredTasteRepair.scope: Exactly one natural, on-scene, non-decorative humorous line is required in both RU and UK intro explanation prose. It repairs taste only and must not change curriculum, grammar, new-word scope, target inventory, task count, or scene.
requiredTasteRepair.ru: Если в листовке написано `shops`, не пытайтесь пристроить к ним `a`: одному магазину оно нужно, нескольким — уже тесно.
requiredTasteRepair.uk: Якщо в листівці написано `shops`, не намагайтеся прилаштувати до них `a`: одному магазину воно потрібне, кільком — уже тісно.
requiredTasteRepair.placement: Use once in the plural `shops` intro explanation, immediately after the article/number contrast; do not place it in the prompt, feedback, final, or a standalone joke.
requiredTasteRepair.acceptance: Both locales must preserve the same language-based joke and delivery-leaflet context. The line must explain why plural shops have no a; it cannot add a person, a made-up event, or an unrelated comic detail.
